data.name: Contract Terminated
data.detailed_description:
Your band of mercenaries was sent on a mission to a remote planet. Your agent said it was a standard "pacify the locals" mission.

Shortly after arrival, you received a message that your contract had been terminated. Without explanation. Without pay. Without transport home.

Now, stranded on a hostile planet in the middle of nowhere, you need to find a way to ensure the survival of your company until you can secure transport home. With limited equipment and resources, it won't be easy.

Contract Terminated features 16-color pixelated retro graphics and a top-down world map with grid-based movement and first-person party-based dungeon crawling. Fight tactical turn-based battles with your group of mercenaries and level up their skills and equipment in order to survive and eventually dominate the harsh world you've been stranded on.

This game is an oldschool 1980s-style RPG inspired by games like Ultima, Legacy of the Ancients, and Buck Rogers: Countdown to Doomsday.
